text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, are you sure it's okay?
Won't we get scolded after all?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's toootally fine!
If we do it real quick, nobody'll even notice!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
All packed up and ready~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left is to go all out
and party on the beach!"
Huh, how so?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Um,
Good mornin'☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My, what happened to your usual sun-like smile?
Could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Do you realize that what you're doing
might actually get you scolded?

text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sowwy!!
I'm sorry!!

While making preparations for the summer training camp
to hone our skills... I was suddenly summoned
by the Ritto Dormitory head, Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, we had Helios take everything
she stuffed into the bus's trunk out for now.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Just to be safe, I'd like you to double-check if there's anything else we need for training, Trainer...

Lined up there were... swan swim rings,
tropical swim rings, sandbox toy sets,
water guns, surfboards, parasols, sharks—
choice_data_list: …Would it be alright if I just had one swim ring?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Mount Pien!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Geez. It's you, Helios—surely you can have fun even without any toys, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's leave this storage space empty
so the other girls can use it too.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaay...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hau~n...
There goes my plan to turn the sea into a night pool.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, guess we got scolded after all~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "...Though I did secretly bring a water gun♪"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bestieee~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Besties 4 life, no cap!!
Let's make tons of memories this summer!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Same here, same here!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Camp is totally about making memories anyway!
When besties are always together, it's a non-stop party☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
About that... sorry!
Forever together might be impossible.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to enter the summer races.
Looks like I'll be away for quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait, really?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then wouldn't it be fine if I tagged along too?
You need cheering on, right!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Mount Pien dosukoi-maru!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thanks, Helios.
Just keep me company in spirit, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
I'm gonna go out there and give it my absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: As Helios's bestie, I wanna be someone she can be proud of too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Palmer-chin...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ain't nothing to be embarrassed about, Palmer-chin!
Even if you totally flop, I wouldn't feel embarrassed at all!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No, that's not what I mean!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It means I'm getting serious!
Helios, you gotta do your best and get super strong too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You're gonna be Ojo's fav crush, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty!
Time for me to get serious too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna beat Bamboo in the Mile Championship!!
And then I'll become the ultimate party animal!!"

Thanks to Mejiro Palmer,
Daitaku Helios got her motivation back too.
And so, a scorching summer training camp—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Ugh, it's so hot today...
I literally can't even, it's such a drag.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Jordaaan!!!!
Let's hang out~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah! Don't jump on me~!
You're way too hooooot!!!!
...A fiery summer training camp should be getting underway.
